sources.mps-fp8: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/132624 (MPS has no float8 dtypes); https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/issues/9255 (Wan2.2 fp8 template fails on Apple Silicon)
sources.mps-fp8-workaround: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/issues/5533 (use fp16/bf16 or GGUF, or PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK=1 / --cpu, very slow)
sources.nvfp4: https://blog.comfy.org/p/new-comfyui-optimizations-for-nvidia (NVFP4 accelerated only on Blackwell + cu130; elsewhere dequantized, up to 2x slower than fp8)
sources.int8-convrot: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/comfy-quants/blob/main/docs/quantization/README.md (INT8 tensorwise/ConvRot native in ComfyUI>=0.27, CUDA SM>=7.5; other hardware dequantizes); https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/issues/14824 (slower than fp8 on A100)
sources.vram-guidance: https://modelvram.com/image-video-vram-calculator/ (Wan2.2 A14B fp8 720p/81f 14.9-19.0 GB; LTX-2 19B fp8 1280x720/121f 27.2-30.2 GB; FLUX.2 dev fp8 35-37 GB at 1MP with encoder swapped out); https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/video/wan/wan2_2 (one 14B expert resident at a time, native offloading)
sources.mps-bf16: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/metalperformanceshaders/mpsdatatype (bfloat16 on MPS needs macOS 14+; PyTorch errors on older macOS)
